evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any specific concerns or stressors about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after full logistics/inventory intake, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer said 'we've used you guys several times so I know the process pretty well... I don't have any questions, really' — nothing surfaced to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the 5 lines reached — no rate-commit line, no pay-less-if-faster line, no self-prep tip, and no 'does that feel fair' check before the rep unilaterally confirms the schedule.
